content.title:
Allen Parr on Instagram: "The Bible gives us clear signs about the Antichrist.

He will perform false miracles, speak against God, stage a counterfeit resurrection, rise to global influence, and require a mark to buy or sell as a sign of loyalty to him (2 Thess. 2:9–10; Rev. 13:16–17).

This level of deception isn’t driven by human effort. Scripture says it will be empowered directly by Satan (2 Thess. 2:9).

We don’t know the day or hour when the Antichrist will appear. But as we live in the last days, it’s essential that we understand what God’s Word actually says. Knowing Scripture protects us from being misled, whether by speculation about world leaders or by the Antichrist himself when he is revealed.

Stay rooted in truth. Your discernment begins with God’s Word. 

#antichrist #theantichrist #theendtimes #fyp"
